items.heading: Adoption of the 2025 California Fire Code with Local Amendments – Second Reading
items.action: Action: M/S/C (Ishii/Taplin) to adopt the second reading of Ordinance No. 7,990– N.S. Further, refer Sections 503.2.1, 503.2.2, and 503.4.1 and Appendix D, including section D105.2, to the City Manager and the Facilities, Infrastructure, Transportation, Environment & Sustainability (FITES) Policy Committee to develop and recommend revisions for Council consideration by April 2026. The Mayor will submit an agenda item for a meeting in January 2026 with a referral for staff to develop Transportation Design Standards. Vote: Ayes – Kesarwani, Taplin, Tregub, O’Keefe, Blackaby, Lunaparra, Humbert, Ishii; Noes – None; Abstain – None; Absent – Bartlett.

items.heading: Adoption of and Amendments to the California Wildland-Urban Interface (WUI) Code – Second Reading
items.action: Action: M/S/C (Blackaby/Humbert) to adopt the second reading of Ordinance No. 7,991–N.S. and approve the recommendations below. • Thank the members of the WUI Vegetation Code Workgroup for their efforts, including their very detailed and thoughtful recommendations in 2 letters back to Council; • Refer to the City Manager the items in the Workgroup's letter (including non- combustible trash & recycling bins, wood shake roofs, wire mesh size for Vector Control, and facilitating permitting of metal privacy screens to replace privacy hedges) to then return to Council with specific proposals for consideration; and • After the State Board of Forestry finalizes its Zone Zero regulations, request that the City Manager reconvene the Workgroup to help provide feedback on the differences between the state and local vegetation management laws (if any), such that the City Manager can then report back to City Council with an update within 90 days of the state's new rules. Vote: Ayes – Kesarwani, Taplin, Tregub, O’Keefe, Blackaby, Lunaparra, Humbert, Ishii; Noes – None; Abstain – None; Absent – Bartlett.

vote.as_printed: Vote: Ayes – Kesarwani, Taplin, Tregub, O’Keefe, Blackaby, Lunaparra, Humbert, Ishii; Noes – None; Abstain – None; Absent – Bartlett.
